comment: Prototype (untested here, PDAL not installed in sandbox; needs PDAL >= 2.6 for WHERE-expressions). Reclassify class-6 points that are vegetation-like and not on a locally planar patch to class 5. Usage: pdal pipeline pdal_roof_veg.json --readers.las.filename=in.laz --writers.las.filename=out.laz [--filters.colorization.raster=dop_rgbi.vrt]

pipeline.comment: OPTIONAL: remove this stage when the LAZ already carries Red+Infrared (PF8 / bDOM). Overwrites Red; use a VRT over DOP COGs/JP2s.

value: VegCue = 1 WHERE Classification == 6 && NumberOfReturns > 1 && ReturnNumber < NumberOfReturns

pipeline.comment: SurfaceVariation = l3/(l1+l2+l3); computed on all points within knn, consider running on class-6-only view (filters.range + merge) for cleaner neighbourhoods

value: Classification = 5 WHERE Classification == 6 && VegCue == 1 && NDVI > 0.55 && NumberOfReturns > 1 && ReturnNumber < NumberOfReturns
